top_signals.title: Onshore Yuan Snaps Winning Streak as PBOC Lifts FX Reserve Ratio
top_signals.summary: The onshore yuan ended its longest winning streak in three decades after the People’s Bank of China moved to cool its rally by asking banks to hold more foreign currencies in reserve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
